title: HelperSessionReplayResult
description: Result of the session service's replay op: one frame per mark, in the order the marks were given. A replay carries no revision and no completeness — those are a runtime's facts and there is no runtime here — and the shape of each frame is the same one a live session's screen read answers with, because two shapes would have been two decoders and the second would have been written by reading the first.

frames.description: Never null: no marks is an empty array, which is an answer rather than a missing one.
